notes: List prices before tax. Plans with verified=false are estimates to confirm. effective_monthly = price_monthly, or price_annual/12 when the plan is annual-only. checked_at is when prices were last researched; official_url is the company pricing page (not link-checked from the build environment); sources are the pages the prices were read from.

value_models.usage: cost per use = annual cost / uses per year; compared to the service's benchmark.
value_models.insurance: value comes from protection, not frequent use; judged mainly by overlaps and claims.
value_models.storage: judged by whether a smaller storage tier would fit what you store.
value_models.perks: net value = dollar value of perks used per year minus the annual fee.

overlap_tags.label: AI assistant
overlap_tags.advice: Most people need one paid AI assistant. Keep the one you open daily; drop the other or move it to a free tier.

overlap_tags.label: Cloud storage
overlap_tags.advice: You may be paying for storage in more than one place (iCloud+, OneDrive, Google). Consolidate where your photos and backups live.

overlap_tags.label: VPN
overlap_tags.advice: VPN is bundled in several services; you only need one.

overlap_tags.label: Password manager
overlap_tags.advice: Apple Passwords and Google Password Manager are free; paid ones in security suites overlap.

overlap_tags.label: Identity / dark web monitoring
overlap_tags.advice: Monitoring from two providers gives the same alerts twice.

overlap_tags.label: Data broker removal
overlap_tags.advice: Two removal services hit mostly the same broker list.

overlap_tags.label: Identity theft insurance
overlap_tags.advice: You can only claim a loss once; duplicate policies rarely add value. Check your homeowner's/renter's policy too.

overlap_tags.label: Email aliases
overlap_tags.advice: iCloud+ Hide My Email already gives unlimited aliases on Apple devices.

overlap_tags.label: Notes app
overlap_tags.advice: OneNote comes with Microsoft 365, and Apple Notes is free.

overlap_tags.label: Business news
overlap_tags.advice: WSJ, CNBC and Apple News+ cover the same market news; pick the format you actually use.

overlap_tags.label: Music streaming
overlap_tags.advice: Apple One, YouTube Premium and Amazon Prime each include a music service.

overlap_tags.label: Video streaming
overlap_tags.advice: Rotate video services month to month instead of holding all of them.

overlap_tags.label: Antivirus
overlap_tags.advice: Microsoft Defender is free on Windows and included in Microsoft 365.

overlap_tags.label: Roadside assistance
overlap_tags.advice: Check your car insurance, vehicle warranty and credit cards before renewing AAA.

services.name: Spotify Premium

recent_changes.summary: US prices rose $1-2 on every plan (Individual $11.99 to $12.99).

tips: Duo or Family split with others cuts per-person cost to about $9.50 or $3.67.
If you have Apple One or YouTube Premium you already pay for a music service.

discounts.label: Duo or Family plan shared with others
discounts.note: Family $21.99 split 6 ways is about $3.67 each

pause_policy.notes: No pause; after cancelling, the account and playlists stay on the free tier.

services.name: Netflix

recent_changes.summary: Price increase on all plans: Standard now $19.99, Premium $26.99.

tips: Most people don't need Premium; 4K only matters on a 4K TV.
Rotate: cancel between shows you want and resubscribe for a month at a time.

discounts.label: Included with some phone plans (e.g. T-Mobile)

pause_policy.notes: No pause; profiles and history are kept for about 10 months after cancelling.

services.name: Evernote

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: Monthly-equivalent of $99/yr; monthly billing is higher.

recent_changes.summary: Plans renamed to Starter/Advanced; Starter caps at 1,000 notes and 20 notebooks.

tips: OneNote (in Microsoft 365) and Apple Notes cover most note-taking for no extra cost.
Check your note count: Starter's 1,000-note cap may push you to Advanced.

pause_policy.notes: No pause option; cancel and resubscribe later at the current list price. Account drops to Free and its 50-note limit.

services.name: The Wall Street Journal
tips: The intro rate ends after 12 months and the price jumps about 10x; set a reminder.
Calling to cancel often triggers a retention offer near the intro price.
Apple News+ (in Apple One Premier) includes a selection of WSJ stories.

discounts.label: Ask for a retention rate when cancelling

pause_policy.notes: Digital has no pause (print has vacation holds). Cancelling ends the intro rate.

services.name: CNBC+ / CNBC Pro

features.name: Live CNBC and CNBC World stream
Analyst calls, Pro Playbook and real-time alerts
Live Pro Talks and special reports

recent_changes.summary: CNBC+ launched as a lower-priced streaming tier without a cable login.

tips: Jim Cramer's Investing Club is a separate subscription ($49.99/mo or $399.99/yr), not part of Pro.
If you have cable or a live-TV streamer, CNBC is already included.
Overlaps with WSJ for market news; most people need one, not both.

pause_policy.notes: No pause option; cancel and resubscribe later at the current list price.

services.name: AAA Membership

plans.name: Classic

Hotel, rental car and retail discounts

tips: Car insurance roadside add-ons, new-car warranties and some credit cards cover tows; check before renewing.

discounts.note: Promo seen at AAA Hoosier; varies by club

services.name: Apple iCloud+

features.name: Share with up to 5 family members

tips: Already included in Apple One (50 GB / 200 GB / 2 TB); don't pay for both.
Check Settings > iCloud to see how much you use; many people can drop a tier.

discounts.label: Share any 200 GB+ plan with up to 5 family members

pause_policy.notes: No pause; you can downgrade any time. Backups stop if you're over the new limit.

services.name: Microsoft 365

plans.name: Personal Classic (no Copilot)
plans.note: Hidden plan; reachable by starting to cancel.

features.name: Copilot AI in Office apps (60 credits/mo)

recent_changes.summary: Copilot bundled in; prices rose $3/mo. Classic plans without AI kept at old price.

tips: Don't use Copilot? Switch to Personal Classic at $69.99/yr (start the cancel flow to see it).
Family covers 6 people with 1 TB each for $30/yr more than Personal.

discounts.label: Personal Classic without Copilot, $69.99/yr
discounts.note: Shown when you start to cancel

discounts.label: Family plan covers 6 people for $30/yr more than Personal

services.name: Cloaked
services.use_unit: time you used an alias or masked number
tips: Overlaps heavily with McAfee+ (VPN, passwords, data cleanup, monitoring). Pick one.
iCloud+ Hide My Email gives free email aliases if you're on Apple.

services.name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Card (Chase)

features.name: Free first checked bag for you + up to 8 companions

recent_changes.summary: Fees raised (Priority to $229) after Southwest began charging $35 for a first checked bag.
Announced Rapid Rewards changes take effect; re-check value then.

tips: Value check: (checked bags you'd pay $35 each for) + (anniversary points at ~1.3¢) + discounts vs. the fee.
Rapid Rewards membership itself is free; only the card has a fee.

pause_policy.notes: Card fees can't be paused; ask Chase for a product change to avoid the fee.

services.name: McAfee+
tips: Renewal jumps ~3x after year one; call or chat to ask for the first-year price again.
Windows Defender (free) and Microsoft 365's Defender cover basic antivirus.

discounts.label: Ask for the first-year price again at renewal

pause_policy.notes: No pause; the first-year intro price is lost once it renews.

services.name: ChatGPT

recent_changes.summary: Lower-priced Go tier added; Free and Go may show ads.
Pro split into Pro 100, Pro 200 and a new Pro 500 tier.

tips: Paying for ChatGPT and Claude (and Copilot in Microsoft 365) is the most common AI overlap.
If you use it a few times a week, Free or Go may be enough.

pause_policy.notes: No pause; cancel at the end of the billing period and resubscribe any time.

services.name: Claude
tips: Annual Pro is $200/yr ($16.67/mo), saving $40 vs monthly.

pause_policy.notes: No pause; cancel at the end of the billing period and resubscribe any time.
